question.text: What is the minimum corpus that a Cat I or Cat II AIF scheme must raise under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations prescribe a minimum scheme corpus of INR 20 crore for every AIF scheme. The workbook also notes a carve-out of INR 5 crore for Social Impact Fund schemes. The Trap: INR 10 cr, INR 25 cr and INR 50 cr are not the prescribed scheme corpus floor. Note: The workbook supports the INR 20 crore minimum corpus per scheme and the INR 5 crore Social Impact Fund carve-out. Any prior reference to a lower Angel Fund threshold has been removed as the checked Angel Fund pages do not support that claim.
